author: Melito of Sardis
blurb: Melito of Sardis' paschal homily (c. 180), lost for over a millennium and recovered from 20th-century papyrus finds. Transcription in progress: sections 9-13 resolved; sections 1-8 transcribed diplomatically (fragmentary opening leaves) pending the collation pass.
edition: Project transcription from the papyrus witnesses, Phase 1 first pass (2026-10-25, Spark). Greek text transcribed from the served images of P. Bodmer XIII (Fondation Martin Bodmer, Bodmer Lab IIIF, CC BY-NC 4.0); P. Chester Beatty XII collation pending (CSNTM high-resolution viewer requires a free account login; only 100 px thumbnails are served anonymously). NO modern edition's text is copied: Bonner 1940 is under US copyright until 1 Jan 2036 (renewed 10 Sep 1968, R442133); Hall 1979 and Perler SC 123 (1966) are collation references only. Diplomatic transcripts and per-page notes: transcriptions/ in the book folder.
title: On the Pascha (Peri Pascha)
